title: Hanasato Minori — Expanding Circle Of Friendship〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great practice today.
I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Bye, Minori, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bye, Shizuku. Alright, Minori, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I've sort of been looking forward to walking home with you, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we don't really live near each other and usually just go our separate ways after school...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly, but I'm heading your way today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right, the Japanese confectionary shop you like so much. I haven't been there in a while either. I'm feeling a rice cake craving coming.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you wanted one when we went to see the cherry blossoms too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like them, you know? Oh, we're here...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Since we're here, maybe I'll get something too. Hm...? Airi, there's something posted on the window...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. Let's see... Today and tomorrow only! Special discounts on rice cakes and other sweets...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi, does this mean...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, Minori!
It's time for that!
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
So there's something you need to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Do you remember what we talked about when went to see those cherry blossoms the other day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When we went to see the cherry blossoms? Something about this being an important time in our lives and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know! A Japanese sweets party! Airi was looking forward to having one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ding! Ding! Ding! We have a winner!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And your reward will be...
An assortment of Japanese sweets!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow...!
So many kinds of rice cakes...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, she wasn't kidding!
Where did you get these, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The confectionary shop we went by yesterday was having a sale...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We decided to ask the shop to deliver us some freshly made sweets for this occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. I've actually been looking forward to doing this as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
Just for today, we can take a break and eat whatever we like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I have tea too, so bon appetite!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, enough talk.
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm... These rice cakes are so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They are. The bean paste is so well made too. I might need to be careful with these...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? It's so easy to get carried away with these...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're grinning, Minori.
Are you having that much fun?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just thinking that it's so nice that we've been getting to spend more time with each other.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, this is where we all first met too, isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. I met you when you were in the middle of dance practice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then you two ran into Shizuku and me when we were arguing about something...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Then we met Miku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The first time we went to SEKAI, everyone looked so down even though we got to see such an amazing show...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's not true that you have nothing more to give.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It was a little tough when I couldn't express how I really felt...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But we were able to come together and form MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It still feels like a dream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it does. It took us a while, but everything started happening so fast too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll have some long days ahead of us, but it'll all just fly by us in the end.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. That's why we need to spend each and every day meaningfully.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly! We just gotta keep doing what we need to do, keep making video and we'll have a million followers before we know it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A million...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You heard me! We gotta aim high, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You're right, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're a member of MORE MORE JUMP! too, Minori, so you'll have to keep doing your best too, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right. I have a fan now too. Someone that's out there supporting me!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm still only at one, but I want to be able to deliver hope to more and more people!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna do my best!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, huh...? Cherry blossom petals...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They could be from the tree in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they're pretty, so I say it's a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's as if they're cheering us on as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You might be right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright! Let's all keep doing everything we can! More and more and more!!
